scope.title: Thống kê và thu thập dữ liệu

skills.focus: Distinguish numerical/categorical values; avoid confusing a variable name with its observed value.
Choose methods fit for a measurable question, observation time, population and recording accuracy.
Read actual numerical values, units and comparisons from complete text-specified bar-chart datasets.

scope.id_range: STA21NEW_001 through STA21NEW_012 (draft IDs; ChatGPT normalizes final IDs)

source_lock.rule: Use source bundle as authoritative: reject duplicate or near-duplicate existing questions, preserve exact skill IDs and Core mapping; proposed refinements not auto promoted.

question_shape.question: Vietnamese question with all necessary data
options: A
B
C
D
hints: more concrete hint without giving answer

constraints: 12 items exactly, 4 per whitelisted skill; 4 unique answer options and exactly one correct answer; answer integer 0..3, vary correct position; no ambiguous chart values or reading diagrams to scale.
At least 4 tasks interpret a realistic dataset, at least 3 check a common misconception with plausible distractors.
No new diagram asset needed in this first batch; for bar-chart items state the entire categorical data table within the question and use correct units.
Do not invent statistics or claim survey facts are real: label small datasets hypothetical.
Explanations show values/operation and units; make errors diagnostically useful.
Every scored item has exactly one assessed skill. No cross-credit for supporting skills.
Keep hints in author draft only; these will not be attached to Core Readiness; this batch is interactive Practice Bank only.
Do not change or claim to have committed repository files; return only one complete JSON packet.

invariants.evidence_rule: Formative practice and readiness assessment evidence remain separate; do not mechanically merge them into one mastery score.

invariants.soft_mastery: Readiness recommends next action; it never blocks the next topic.

golden_template.rollout_policy: Apply by topic/strand batch. Do not create per-card rollout PRs unless fixing a verified defect.
